name: IMT Advisor Sales and Opportunity Performance (v2)

dataset.name: IMT Advisor Sales and Opportunity Performance Model

derived_metrics.name: YTD Sales Change
derived_metrics.formula: ([Year To Date Total Sales Amount] - [Prior Year To Date Total Sales Amount]) / [Prior Year To Date Total Sales Amount]

derived_metrics.name: VA Sales Change
derived_metrics.formula: ([Year To Date Variable Annuity Sales Amount] - [Prior Year To Date Variable Annuity Sales Amount]) / [Prior Year To Date Variable Annuity Sales Amount]

derived_metrics.name: FA Sales Change
derived_metrics.formula: ([Year To Date Fixed Annuity Sales Amount] - [Prior Year To Date Fixed Annuity Sales Amount]) / [Prior Year To Date Fixed Annuity Sales Amount]

derived_metrics.name: FIA Sales Change
derived_metrics.formula: ([Year To Date Fixed Indexed Annuity Sales Amount] - [Prior Year To Date FIA Sales Amount]) / [Prior Year To Date FIA Sales Amount]

derived_metrics.name: LIA Sales Change
derived_metrics.formula: ([Year To Date Lifetime Income Annuity Sales Amount] - [Prior Year To Date Lifetime Income Annuity Sales Amount]) / [Prior Year To Date Lifetime Income Annuity Sales Amount]

derived_metrics.name: Advisor Rank
derived_metrics.formula: Rank<ASC=False>([Year To Date Total Sales Amount])

derived_metrics.name: Year to date
derived_metrics.formula: (Sum(If([Producer Category]@ID = "Active Producer", [Year To Date Total Sales Amount], 0))) / 1000000

derived_metrics.name: Prior year to date
derived_metrics.formula: (Sum(If([Producer Category]@ID = "Active Producer", [Prior Year To Date Total Sales Amount], 0))) / 1000000
